title: Behavior Hurt By Target
description: Allows the mob to target another mob that hurts them.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

alert_same_type.description: Whether the entity alerts other entities of the same type to also target.

hurt_owner.description: Whether the entity retaliates when its owner is hurt.
